items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); the attached delivery certificate on page 2 states 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' (a Saturday). For formal service there is no deemed-delivery fiction; the actual service date (21.11.2026) is the triggering event. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (applicable via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG, § 43 StPO) the day of service itself is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026. The two-week Einspruchsfrist of § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG then ends two weeks later, on Sat 05.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). As that day is a Saturday, under § 43 StPO i.V.m. § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026. The objection must reach the Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg (in writing or zur Niederschrift) by that date.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag) after the decision becomes final
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after 'Eintritt der Rechtskraft' (the decision becoming final). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft occurs the day after the Einspruchsfrist expires unused, i.e. on 08.12.2026 (the day after the objection deadline of 07.12.2026 computed above). Counting the two-week payment period from that event under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (the event day is not counted) gives a start of 09.12.2026, ending two weeks later on Tue 22.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). 22.12.2026 is a normal business day (not a Brandenburg holiday), so no weekend/holiday shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG). Note: this date only holds if no Einspruch is filed; filing an objection would suspend Rechtskraft and this payment deadline entirely.

warnings: The payment due date (22.12.2026) assumes no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; filing an objection suspends Rechtskraft and removes this payment obligation until the matter is decided.

The sender's e-mail address domain ('zentraldienst-der-polizei-mu.example') uses the reserved '.example' top-level domain, which is never used for real correspondence — this looks like placeholder/test data and the letter's authenticity should be verified through an official, independently looked-up channel before relying on it or paying anything.

Before paying, verify the IBAN (DE70 1600 0000 0005 8312 00, held at 'Landesmusterbank') against an officially published payment channel for the Brandenburg police Bußgeldstelle; the IBAN is technically well-formed but that does not confirm the account holder.
The delivery certificate records service ('zugestellt am') as 21.11.2026, a Saturday; confirm this date is correct since it is the anchor for the two-week Einspruch deadline.
